name: Pillar Gallery
pitch: Vertical image pillars that rise on hover and seamlessly expand into a towering fullscreen gallery with ambient color echoes and floating typography.

lifecycle.idle: All pillars rest at baseline with elegant subtle heights.
lifecycle.discovery: Entering a pillar triggers dramatic vertical rise and sibling dimming.
lifecycle.buildUp: Clicking initiates in-place FLIP expansion and harmonic sibling push-away.
lifecycle.peak: Monolith occupies 91vh with ambient mood lighting and floating title.
lifecycle.recovery: Dismissing collapses the monolith cleanly back into its starting pillar slot.
